_meta.usage: full landline number in national form: 02-312-3456, 02-2123-4567, 051-212-3456; drop a leading +82. A bare code is not accepted, so other countries' codes don't match
_meta.note: 17 codes since the 2000 consolidation (044 Sejong added 2012), one per province-level unit before the 2026 Jeonnam–Gwangju merger. Exceptions listed in ko.wikipedia are kept as extra matches with a note. Formats overlap with other packs and can't be told apart: a 9-digit 02 number is also an Israeli Jerusalem number, and 10–11-digit numbers starting 031–033, 041–044, 051–055 or 061–064 can be Sri Lankan or Turkish (e.g. 0312 Ankara); pass --country when the country is known. A few businesses wired to a neighbouring exchange (e.g. 032 in part of Seoul's Gangseo-gu) are not listed.
_meta.miss_note: not a South Korean geographic number: 010 mobile, 070 VoIP, 050/060/080 services, 15xx/16xx nationwide numbers
